about_the_game:
Strike from the shadows with deadly precision and vanish before your enemies hit the ground.

The Assassin Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original equips silent killers and master tacticians with the ultimate tools of death. Whether you're a lone stalker in the night or a tactical ambusher on the battlefield, this gear set will amplify your lethality and keep you one step ahead of your prey.

  • Guidance of Goddess – A divine one-handed sword that blesses assassins with enhanced awareness and spiritual clarity, sharpening reflexes in the heat of battle.

  • Messenger of Underworld – A claw whispered to be a gift from the realm of the dead, delivering swift judgment to the living.

  • Endless Darkness – A mystical blade enveloped in eternal night, empowering its wielder with shadow-infused strength.

  • Bow of Rainstorm – A versatile ranged weapon that rains arrows upon foes like a passing storm, swift and merciless.

  • Time and Space Destroyer – A powerful crossbow infused with temporal magic, capable of piercing dimensions and striking with uncanny precision. Ideal for ranged assassins who bend space and time to their will.

  • Unstable Balanced Dagger – A dangerously sharp weapon requiring precision and daring, dealing devastating critical blows when used skillfully.

Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Set:

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Cap

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Chest

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Leggings

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Gloves

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Boots

A deadly lightweight armor set engineered for agility, evasion, and silent killing. Designed for those who thrive in chaos and leave no witnesses.

Step into the shadows with the Assassin Equipment Package—gear tailored for the masters of stealth, sabotage, and speed. Unleash your fury in 4Story: The Original, where silence is your weapon and death is your legacy.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.

  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
